subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should OpenClaw escalate repeated channel restart failures or alive-but-unresponsive Gateway health failures to a supervised process restart by default?
rationale: The source symptom is credible, but the safest recovery boundary affects operator lifecycle semantics and was not reproduced by the targeted live harness.

options.title: Require affected-host proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and gather the requested Windows/current-main log and probe window before changing supervisor behavior.

options.title: Adopt supervisor escalation
options.body: Define a bounded restart escalation policy after repeated channel recovery failures, with platform-specific upgrade proof.

options.title: Split narrow transport trackers
options.body: Move only the Telegram outbound/socket and session-lane pieces into narrower issues and leave Gateway process restart policy unchanged.

recommendation.title: Require affected-host proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and gather the requested Windows/current-main log and probe window before changing supervisor behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already ran the closest live repro attempt and requested the exact missing proof needed before a recovery-policy decision.
